text:
maya: urgent heads-up — embeddings in prod-eu returning intermittent 502s for short prompts. I traced to a tokenizer boundary fallback. I have a hotfix image tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix that passed unit tests and staging integration. Requesting expedited ops clearance for a staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) starting in ~20m. @kevin @sasha @ops-duty pls review and stamp.

kevin: checked staging traces — looks like a rare tokenizer split. +1 for rollout if rollback is automated and Dedicated customers get image pin.

sasha: need explicit abort/rollback criteria before I approve. Don’t want surprise hit to SLAs.

maya: rollback criteria: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases >2% absolute over baseline sustained for 5m OR p50 latency increases >150ms sustained for 5m. Manual rollback: `/deploybot rollback service=embedder version=previous`. We keep previous image on standby. Release notes draft: https://short.redwood/release/6390 (staging).

ops-duty: oncall ack. Will only grant expedite once Dedicated image sha is pinned and CS gets a blurb. Also request a 30m change window from canary start.

riya: for Dedicated customers pin to sha `sha256:abcd1234ef56deadbeef...7890`. Add note that existing sessions are unaffected; only new tokenization uses hotfix.

deploybot: deploybot: initiating staged rollout: service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix steps=5,25,100 auto-rollback=on-error. Starting canary now. Command: `deploybot rollout --service embedder --image tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix --strategy staged --steps 5,25,100 --auto-rollback on-error`.

kevin: set metric alert to page if error spike >1.5% absolute. Watching.

sasha: sec reviewed diff, no new network or privilege changes. :thumbsup:

ops-duty: expedited approval granted. Change window: +30m from canary start. CS notified to expect brief notice to customers in EU. Maya, paste final release note here.

maya: Release note: "Fix: tokenizer boundary case causing intermittent 502s for short prompts in prod-eu. Rollout: staged canary with auto-rollback on error spike. Hotfix image: tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. Dedicated: pinned to sha256:abcd1234ef56deadbeef...7890."

deploybot: deploybot: canary 5% applied to prod-eu. Monitoring baseline for 5m.

maya: canary green at 10m — error rate flat, latency stable. Proceeding to 25%.

deploybot: deploybot: canary 25% applied. Telemetry window 10m.

kevin: metrics look clean at 25%. No p50/p95 anomalies, no error spike. +1 to go to 100%.

maya: proceeding to 100% now, ETA ~15m to finish ramp.

deploybot: deploybot: ramping to 100%...

deploybot: deploybot: rollout 100% complete for service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. No auto-rollback triggered.

sasha: good work — please do a 2h post-deploy verification and confirm no late regressions.

ops-duty: closing expedite window. Changelog updated and Dedicated pinned. Tagging ops-runbook for post-check.

maya: thanks all. I'll post a 2h verification summary back here."
